position_grant.principle: The committee grants capital to a position only for explicit, monitorable reasons. The runner must keep monitoring those reasons after entry.

thesis_monitoring.score_decay_action: reduce exposure; for micro positions where partial reduction is unreliable, exit full-size
hard_invalidation_reasons: source strategy no longer emits a signal for the symbol
entry regime is no longer present

trend_pullback_candidate_rules.environment_preference: competition if available budget is sufficient; otherwise personal
trend_pullback_candidate_rules.live_gate: candidate strategies may be submitted to the committee only with explicit stop, target, horizon, and source_strategy_id metadata

production_requirement: Every strategy promoted to production must attach a thesis_contract and expose a thesis monitor compatible with investment_committee_thesis_exit_v1.
